stance.name: Anchor stance
stance.text: hit half again as hard; nothing knocks you back

technique.name: Ground Strike
technique.text: A blow that splits the floor and knocks the foe back.

anchor.wall.name: Cannot Be Moved
anchor.wall.text: Nothing moves you while it holds: every blow is turned aside. It ends in a shockwave that staggers.

anchor.weight.name: Ground Strike
anchor.weight.text: A chain of blows that ends in one that splits the floor.

anchor.endurance.name: Second Wind
anchor.endurance.text: The field sets itself right: each cue heals; all of them pay the Terms in health.

stance.name: Element stance
stance.text: every hit sets the foe burning

technique.name: Kindle
technique.text: Fire out of the field, in an arc: it burns for a while after.

turn.element.name: Wildfire
turn.element.text: A chain of burning blows; all of them pay the Terms in fire.

turn.property.name: Hardened
turn.property.text: The field turns your skin to iron while it holds; it ends in a blast that staggers.

turn.conversion.name: Wound into Heat
turn.conversion.text: Every wound becomes heat, and the heat becomes you again.

stance.name: Speed stance
stance.text: you move a third again as fast and dodge for half the Will

technique.name: Closing Strike
technique.text: The field throws you forward and the blow comes with you.

cast.shot.name: Last Word
cast.shot.text: A volley that does not miss; every cue a shot, then the one that counts.

cast.reach.name: Stoop
cast.reach.text: A chain of closing strikes from wherever you stand.

cast.speed.name: Never There
cast.speed.text: Too fast to touch while it holds; it ends in a blow from behind.

stance.name: Foresight stance
stance.text: the world slows: the foe moves at four-fifths speed

technique.name: Read the Break
technique.text: Find the break in the foe's field: a bolt, and for a while every hit lands on the break.

read.sense.name: The Break
read.sense.text: Every cue lands on the break; the last one opens it.

read.foresight.name: The Next Beat
read.foresight.text: You are where the blow is not, every time, while it holds.

read.mending.name: Set Right
read.mending.text: The field set right, cue by cue.

stance.name: Leash stance
stance.text: anything within five paces moves at three-quarters speed

technique.name: Leash
technique.text: A line of field to the foe: it slows, and its bites come late.

bind.leash.name: Short Leash
bind.leash.text: Reel it in and strike, cue after cue.

bind.puppet.name: Strings
bind.puppet.text: Its body is yours while it holds: it cannot bite you. It ends with it on the floor.

bind.contract.name: Collection
bind.contract.text: The foe pays: what it loses, you gain.

stance.name: Summon stance
stance.text: a conjured blade strikes beside every hit you land

technique.name: Ward
technique.text: A post of field rises at your side and takes the next bite meant for you.

make.form.name: Forged
make.form.text: A conjured weapon for every cue, and the last one the size of a door.

make.ward.name: Bulwark
make.ward.text: Walls of field around you while it holds; they fall outward.

make.summon.name: Second Pair of Hands
make.summon.text: A construct strikes beside you on every cue.
